instruction: Pass a repository secret named API_TOKEN into a step through the env map.
output:
name: secret-env
on: push
jobs:
  call:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Call API
        env:
          API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" https://api.example.com/health

instruction: Use an environment-scoped secret by assigning the job to the production environment.
output:
name: env-secret
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy
        env:
          DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}
        run: ./scripts/deploy.sh

instruction: Use the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN with curl to fetch repository metadata from the GitHub API.
output:
name: github-token-api
on: push
jobs:
  meta:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fetch repository info
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }} | jq -r '.full_name'

instruction: Publish an npm package using a secret registry token configured through setup-node registry-url.
output:
name: npm-auth
on:
  release:
    types: [published]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm ci && npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

instruction: Write an SSH private key from secrets to disk and copy a release to a server with rsync.
output:
name: ssh-deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install SSH key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          echo "${{ secrets.SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS }}" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
      - name: Copy release
        run: rsync -az --delete dist/ deploy@server.example.com:/srv/app/

instruction: Mask a generated value at runtime with the add-mask workflow command before printing it.
output:
name: mask-value
on: push
jobs:
  secret-gen:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Generate and mask
        run: |
          VALUE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
          echo "::add-mask::$VALUE"
          echo "Temporary value is $VALUE"

instruction: Store a JSON service account key from a secret into a file that Google Cloud tooling can load.
output:
name: json-secret-file
on: push
jobs:
  auth:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write key file
        env:
          SA_KEY: ${{ secrets.GCP_SA_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$SA_KEY" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/sa.json"
          gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/sa.json"
      - run: gcloud config list

instruction: Map three configuration variables from the vars context into one job's environment.
output:
name: multiple-vars
on: push
jobs:
  configure:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      APP_NAME: ${{ vars.APP_NAME }}
      APP_URL: ${{ vars.APP_URL }}
      FEATURE_FLAG: ${{ vars.FEATURE_FLAG }}
    steps:
      - run: env | grep -E '^(APP_|FEATURE_)'

instruction: Fall back to a default branch when the DEPLOY_BRANCH variable is not defined.
output:
name: vars-fallback
on: push
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_BRANCH || 'main' }}
      - run: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD

instruction: Create an .npmrc file that authenticates to a private GitHub Packages registry with a secret token.
output:
name: npmrc-token
on: push
jobs:
  install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Configure registry auth
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=$NPM_TOKEN" > .npmrc
          echo "registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com" >> .npmrc
      - run: npm ci

instruction: Import a GPG private key from secrets and configure git to create signed commits.
output:
name: gpg-sign
on: push
jobs:
  signed-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Import GPG key
        env:
          GPG_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$GPG_PRIVATE_KEY" | gpg --batch --import
          git config --global user.signingkey "${{ secrets.GPG_KEY_ID }}"
          git config --global gpg.program "gpg"
      - run: git commit -S -m "signed by workflow" || true

instruction: Provide AWS access keys from secrets to the AWS CLI in a job that lists buckets.
output:
name: aws-keys
on: push
jobs:
  aws:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: List buckets
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

instruction: Send a Slack notification with a webhook URL stored as a secret when the build fails.
output:
name: slack-failure
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure()
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data "{\"text\":\"Build ${{ github.run_id }} failed\"}" "$SLACK_WEBHOOK"

instruction: Call a third-party verification API with a secret key while keeping the key out of the command trace.
output:
name: masked-api-call
on: pull_request
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run integration check
        env:
          API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "::add-mask::$API_KEY"
          curl -sS -X POST https://checks.example.com/verify -H "X-Api-Key: $API_KEY" -d @payload.json

instruction: Generate a config.json from a base64-encoded secret before starting the application.
output:
name: base64-config
on: push
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Decode config
        env:
          CONFIG_B64: ${{ secrets.APP_CONFIG_B64 }}
        run: echo "$CONFIG_B64" | base64 -d > config.json
      - run: ./scripts/start.sh

instruction: Combine a repository variable for the API URL with a secret token for an authenticated request.
output:
name: vars-plus-secret
on: push
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Authenticated request
        env:
          BASE_URL: ${{ vars.API_BASE_URL }}
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$BASE_URL/v1/status"

instruction: Guard a step that uses secrets so it never runs on pull requests from forked repositories.
output:
name: fork-guard
on: pull_request
jobs:
  protected:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Use private secret
        if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
        run: ./scripts/deploy-preview.sh
      - name: Skip notice
        if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
        run: echo "Secrets unavailable for fork pull requests"

instruction: Write a client certificate secret to a file with restrictive permissions and delete it afterwards.
output:
name: secret-file-cleanup
on: push
jobs:
  secure:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Materialize credential
        env:
          CERT: ${{ secrets.CLIENT_CERT }}
        run: |
          umask 077
          printf '%s' "$CERT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/client.pem"
      - run: ./scripts/connect.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/client.pem"
      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/client.pem"
